mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(account.current_balance) FROM connected_account account INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS base_asset, goal.target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(history.amount) / 3) FROM transaction_history history INNER JOIN connected_account account ON account.account_id = history.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND history.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' AND (history.category IS NULL OR history.category != 'ASSET') AND history.transaction_datetime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) ), 0) AS monthly_spending_average, profile.soldier_type, profile.enlistment_date, profile.discharge_date, active_strategy.application_id AS active_strategy_application_id, active_strategy.applied_monthly_spending_amount, active_strategy.applied_monthly_saving_amount, active_strategy.applied_monthly_investment_amount, active_strategy.applied_expected_return_rate FROM soldier_profile profile INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = profile.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN strategy_application active_strategy ON active_strategy.application_id = ( SELECT application.application_id FROM strategy_application application WHERE application.user_id = profile.user_id AND application.source_type = 'AI_RECOMMENDATION' AND application.analysis_id IS NOT NULL AND application.applied_monthly_spending_amount IS NOT NULL AND application.applied_monthly_saving_amount IS NOT NULL AND application.applied_monthly_investment_amount IS NOT NULL AND application.applied_expected_return_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY application.applied_at DESC, application.application_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE profile.user_id = #{userId}
